content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have 5 PLCs of [product_name] type: [article_no]. Is it possible to connect them to Ethernet? Which module would I need for this? Can these be connected to an [company_name] HMI panel? Also, could anyone clarify which version of the [product_name] PLC this is?

Hi, Only the [version_no] and [version_no] versions of the [product_name] PLC come with an RJ45 port. [version_no] is the latest model. You can connect a [company_name] HMI to these versions. For more information, check [url].
I have 2 [product_name] PLCs [version_no], and I've already connected them to a [company_name] HMI. I'd like to know which version of [product_name] this is, specifically referring to [article_no].
Check the last digit of your model number—it's 4.

[article_no] The last part of this number determines the hardware version: [article_no] = Version 4, [article_no] = Version 5, and so forth. [version_no] and [version_no] PLCs feature Ethernet ports, making connection to standard HMI screens possible. There isn't a straightforward way to connect [version_no] to an HMI screen.

analysis.insight_summary: Users are unclear about how older versions of the [product_name] can be connected to Ethernet and HMIs, especially regarding hardware compatibility linked to their article numbers. Understanding the significance of these numbers is essential for connectivity with modern interfaces and devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect clear instructions to identify [product_name] versions based on article numbers, along with direct compatibility information for Ethernet and HMI connections.
